name: B-25 Mitchell
summary: WWII twin-engine medium bomber famous for the Doolittle Raid; dozens fly in the US as airshow and ride warbirds.

wings: Shoulder-mounted wing with a gull-like dihedral break at the engine nacelles
engines: Two big radial engines in long nacelles
fuselage: Glazed bombardier nose (or solid gun nose)
Dorsal gun turret behind the cockpit and tail-gunner position
tail: Twin fins and rudders at the ends of the horizontal tail

tellTales: Twin-radial bomber with twin tail fins
Wing dihedral breaks at the engine nacelles (gull wing)
Tricycle gear with a glazed nose

confusedWith.howToTell: The Beech 18 is much smaller, low-winged and a taildragger; the B-25 has a shoulder gull wing and tricycle gear.
The DC-3 has a single fin and is a low-wing taildragger; the B-25 has twin fins and tricycle gear.
The Invader has a single tall fin and a straight mid wing with a sleek fuselage; the B-25 has twin fins and a gull wing.
